headline: Electric vehicle finance may suit your driving
explanation: Your fuel spending and annual mileage are high for a petrol car. An electric vehicle could reduce operational emissions for the miles you drive. This is an interest signal, not a finance decision.
why_recommended: Fuel spending averaged £310 a month over the last 90 days.
Your vehicle is a petrol car driven about 15,200 km a year.
You currently own a petrol vehicle.
estimated_impact_text: Estimated operational reduction of about 1,670 kg CO2e a year, from a baseline of 2,850 to 1,180 kg CO2e. Manufacturing emissions are excluded.
confidence_text: Confidence is high (0.87) for the data available at 30 June 2026.
action_text: Discuss electric vehicle finance options with an adviser at your next review.
eligibility_disclaimer: Propensity does not establish financial eligibility. Any finance decision follows the bank's authorised product processes.
